requirements.general: i. A pass in SPM with at least credit in any 3 subjects inclusive of Mathematics or any equivalent qualification; OR ii. A pass in STPM with a minimum Grade C (GP 2.0) in any subject and a credit in Mathematics at SPM level or equivalent; OR iii. A pass in STAM with a minimum grade of Maqbul (pass) and a credit in Mathematics at SPM level or equivalent; OR iv. A pass in SKM Level 3 and a credit in Mathematics at SPM level or equivalent; OR v. A pass in any qualifications equivalent to Certificate (Level 3, MQF) and a credit in Mathematics at SPM level or equivalent. Candidates without a credit in Mathematics at SPM level may be admitted if the Certificate programme contains equivalent mathematics subjects. Preferential consideration may be given to those with a credit in computing-related subjects at SPM level or equivalent.
